name: redline
description: A Claude Code plugin that writes ~/.claude/usage.json, shows usage-limit toasts in VS Code sessions where the status line never runs, and adds a /redline command.

toastSeconds.title: Toast duration (seconds)
toastSeconds.description: How long usage toasts stay on screen. Default 6.

alertToastSeconds.title: Alert toast duration (seconds)
alertToastSeconds.description: How long toasts at 95 percent and above, and write-failure toasts, stay on screen. Default 10.

levels.title: Toast levels (percent)
levels.description: Usage percentages that trigger a toast, separated by commas: up to 5 values, from 1 to 100. A toast at 95 percent always appears as well, so there is no need to list it. Default 70, 90.

showFiveHour.title: Show 5-hour toasts
showFiveHour.description: On shows a toast for the 5-hour window. Off hides it. Default On.

showSevenDay.title: Show 7-day toasts
showSevenDay.description: On shows a toast for the 7-day window. Off hides it. Default On.

timeFormat.title: Time format
timeFormat.description: How reset times are shown. System follows your computer's settings. 12-hour and 24-hour use your local time zone. UTC shows 24-hour UTC. Default System.
